stcryptolib_profile.title: Profile selection

oneOf.title: Fast and High
oneOf.description: Optimized for maximum performance: delivers the highest cryptographic throughput (speed) with higher resource usage. Suitable when execution time is critical.

oneOf.title: Small and Low
oneOf.description: Optimized for minimal footprint: reduces code size, memory usage, and power consumption, at the cost of lower performance. Ideal for constrained embedded systems.

oneOf.title: Custom
oneOf.description: User-defined configuration: allows fine-tuning of parameters (performance, memory, features) to match specific project requirements.
